name: decisions-pane
description: A pane in the Claude chat that lists the decisions the agent team's register waits for you on, each with its urgency, context, a pick list or a text box, and a Submit button that records your answer in the register.

registerScript.title: Register script
registerScript.description: The agent team's register.mjs, which records each answer. A leading ~ is your home folder. Its orchestration.config.json (two folders up) names the register files. Only the register of the chat's own repo is shown.

nodePath.title: Node
nodePath.description: The node program that runs the register script: a name on the PATH, or a full path.

pollMs.title: Register refresh (ms)
pollMs.description: How often the registers are read for new or changed decisions, in milliseconds. At least 500.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when a decision waits
autoOpen.description: Opens the Decisions pane by itself when a decision waits for you. Once you close it, it stays closed until a decision it did not show arrives, or until you run /decisions-pane.

paneRows.title: Pane height (lines)
paneRows.description: How tall the pane asks to be above the prompt; a taller list scrolls. The size you drag it to wins.
